fact_text: Pak-Qatar Family Takaful offered 75% of its shares through a book-building IPO, and the CEO said demand was about three times the offer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO had a floor price of PKR 14 per share and a final price fixed at PKR 18.01 per share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO offered a total of 50 million shares.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO said the IPO proceeds would go mainly to growth, with part of the money used to meet the regulator's paid-up capital requirement.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The SECP raised paid-up capital requirements for insurers in three phases in 2025, with the following step taking companies from about PKR 700 million to roughly PKR 1.5 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO said the IPO would let the company meet its paid-up capital requirement for 2028 at once, rather than in stages.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: In takaful, contributions are pooled in a separate entity set up on the waqf principle, and the operator earns a fixed wakala fee rather than owning the pooled money.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: In takaful, claims are paid from the customers' pool to the members who need them, unlike conventional insurance where risk transfers to the insurer's shareholders.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: Conventional insurers historically had no Shariah-compliant investment avenues, so takaful companies must invest their funds in Shariah-compliant assets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The reporter noted that the State Bank has said all banks should become Islamic within about three years, which pushed insurers to look at Islamic products.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: Older conventional life policies carried high allocation charges, so the cash value was low and buyers could take four to six years to break even on their money.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: Pak-Qatar Family Takaful was set up in 2007 and sells life, savings, health and group life covers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: In 2022 Pak-Qatar added an asset management company and a VPS pension licence, and launched an investment-account product where 100% of contributions are invested.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: Pak-Qatar launched a lifetime pension product that covers longevity risk, paying a guaranteed pension for as long as the policyholder lives.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The lifetime pension product has a minimum contribution of PKR 500 per month and accepts applicants up to age 60.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: A variant of the lifetime pension lets a person put a retirement gratuity or lump sum into the fund and still receive a lifetime pension.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO said a mutual-fund annuity pays only until a fixed age, such as 72 or 75, which leaves the buyer exposed to interest-rate and fixed-term risk.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO said the company's top line grew from about PKR 8 billion to about PKR 28 billion, which he said was closed in 2024.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO said the company aimed to close 2025 with a top line of about PKR 32 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO said the company holds about 6% of the total life insurance market, where State Life has about 62%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO said the company has about 44% of total takaful including Windows business, and about 90% of the four dedicated family takaful companies.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO said Qatari investors, including a member of a royal family, backed the company from 2006 and mentored its start.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO promised a dividend of PKR 1 per share from the first board meeting after listing, for new IPO subscribers.

fact_text: The CEO named competitors copying its product launches and marketing as a risk, and said the company tracks rivals regularly to stay ahead.

fact_text: The CEO said digital service security risks are managed through penetration testing, audits and certifications, without which delivering promises is hard.

fact_text: Under SECP guidelines, insurers must warn customers in advance through declarations and messages about the risks of investing in higher-risk stocks.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pak-Qatar Family Takaful IPO Oversubscribed, CEO Explains Growth Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-23)

fact_text: The CEO said the company is building a digital ecosystem covering hardware, software and HR, and that IPO funds would support digital marketing and brand building.
